description: Explore, following C0012 (EfficientNetV2: scale regularization with image size). On E021 at a fixed epoch schedule, weaken regularization only in the 24 px phase. Use label smoothing 0.2 instead of 0.3 and crop translation of 1 px instead of 2, applied before downscaling, during epochs 1-5. The 32 px phase stays at ls 0.3 and 2 px translate. Pass the ls value through the CUDA graph as a GPU scalar tensor, or capture the low-res graph with its own constant, so nothing is recaptured in the timed region. Time should be unchanged.
